name: Landcycle a Forest- or Mountain-cycling creature into a shockland at their end step
intent: At the opponent's end step, with no untapped fetch already on the battlefield to crack instead and at least 1 untapped mana of my own available, discard Generous Ent or Oliphaunt for its own Forestcycling/Mountaincycling {1} ability, searching the library for whatever land it finds. The {1} cost is real mana, not a free discard, so this play stands down without an untapped source to pay it - the same reason open-land-unlocks/open-shock-unlocks/open-fetch-unlocks never fire with no mana to spend. Against the aggressive matchups this play is keyed to (boros-aggro, boros-energy, ur-cutter-prowess - all of which race hard), the search prefers a shockland (Breeding Pool, Steam Vents, Stomping Ground) over a surveil land, since these decks want an untapped land ready to swing back with sooner than the scry is worth; the land only reaches hand here (landcycling puts it into hand, never the battlefield), so no pay_life decision is asked - that choice is the seat's own next turn. Falls back to open-fetch-unlocks/fetch-surveil-land[-keep] whenever an untapped fetch is already out. Never restricted to turns 1-2: a landcycling creature is a fine late-game draw smoothing tool too. Priority 44, alongside landcycle-surveil's 45 and below every turn 1-2 opening play (70-74) and every other pre-openings play in this deck's own corpus (40-65) that is keyed to a specific archetype rather than the wildcard - this play's own `when` fires only on the opponent's end step, never contending with the mine/precombat_main openings for the same land drop.
